### Glacial Defense
*Resists incoming Skill Damage. __Basic Attacks__ are much more effective at piercing its defense!*

### Frost Suppression
*Deals continuous damage while slowing down the attack speed of affected enemies.*

### Knockback Control
*Knocks back and stuns enemies directly in front of it.*

### Area Strike
*Unleashes consecutive area-of-effect (AoE) strikes on enemies in front.*
